title: pogostemon nilagiricus
intro: Pogostemon nilagiricus, commonly known as Nilagiri nila, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress levels. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an adaptogen, promoting balance and stability in the body, as well as its antimicrobial properties, which help to combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Pogostemon nilagiricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
